local function fail(format, ...)
    error({reason = string.format(format, ...)}, 0)
end
local function split(text, separator)
    local result = {}
    local start = 1
    while true do
        local at = text:find(separator, start, true)
        if not at then
            result[#result + 1] = text:sub(start)
            break
        end
        result[#result + 1] = text:sub(start, at - 1)
        start = at + #separator
    end
    return result
end
local function contains(items, value)
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        if item == value then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function series(prefix, n)
    local result = {}
    for i = 1, n do
        result[i] = prefix .. (i - 1)
    end
    return result
end
local function make_automaton(kind, states, alphabet, start)
    local result = {
        kind = kind,
        states = states,
        alphabet = alphabet,
        start = start,
        final = {},
        transitions = {}
    }
    for i = 1, #states do
        result.final[i] = false
        result.transitions[i] = {}
        for c = 1, #alphabet + 1 do
            result.transitions[i][c] = {}
        end
    end
    return result
end
local function add(a, p, c, q)
    local destinations = a.transitions[p][c]
    if not contains(destinations, q) then
        destinations[#destinations + 1] = q
        table.sort(destinations)
    end
end
local function ordered_set(set, n)
    local result = {}
    for i = 1, n do
        if set[i] then
            result[#result + 1] = i
        end
    end
    return result
end
local function closure(a, states)
    local seen, queue = {}, {}
    for _, state in ipairs(states) do
        if not seen[state] then
            seen[state] = true
            queue[#queue + 1] = state
        end
    end
    local i = 1
    while i <= #queue do
        for _, next_state in ipairs(a.transitions[queue[i]][#a.alphabet + 1]) do
            if not seen[next_state] then
                seen[next_state] = true
                queue[#queue + 1] = next_state
            end
        end
        i = i + 1
    end
    return ordered_set(seen, #a.states)
end
local function destination(a, states, c)
    local next_states = {}
    for _, state in ipairs(states) do
        for _, next_state in ipairs(a.transitions[state][c]) do
            next_states[#next_states + 1] = next_state
        end
    end
    return closure(a, next_states)
end
local function accepts(a, states)
    for _, state in ipairs(states) do
        if a.final[state] then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function state_set(a, states)
    local names = {}
    for _, state in ipairs(states) do
        names[#names + 1] = a.states[state]
    end
    return "{" .. table.concat(names, ",") .. "}"
end
local function state_list(a, states)
    if #states == 0 then
        return "none"
    end
    local names = {}
    for _, state in ipairs(states) do
        names[#names + 1] = a.states[state]
    end
    return table.concat(names, ",")
end
local function summary(a, name)
    local finals, count = 0, 0
    for _, accepting in ipairs(a.final) do
        if accepting then
            finals = finals + 1
        end
    end
    for _, row in ipairs(a.transitions) do
        for _, destinations in ipairs(row) do
            count = count + #destinations
        end
    end
    return string.format(
        "%s %s: alphabet=%s states=%d accepting=%d transitions=%d",
        a.kind,
        name,
        a.alphabet,
        #a.states,
        finals,
        count
    )
end
local function set_key(states)
    return table.concat(states, ",")
end
local function determinize(a)
    local sets = {closure(a, {a.start})}
    local indices = {[set_key(sets[1])] = 1}
    local rows = {}
    local i = 1
    while i <= #sets do
        local row = {}
        for c = 1, #a.alphabet do
            local next_states = destination(a, sets[i], c)
            local key = set_key(next_states)
            local index = indices[key]
            if not index then
                index = #sets + 1
                indices[key] = index
                sets[index] = next_states
            end
            row[c] = index
        end
        rows[i] = row
        i = i + 1
    end
    local result = make_automaton("DFA", series("D", #sets), a.alphabet, 1)
    for index, set in ipairs(sets) do
        result.final[index] = accepts(a, set)
        for c, next_state in ipairs(rows[index]) do
            add(result, index, c, next_state)
        end
    end
    return result, sets
end
local function graph_reach(a, starts, reverse)
    local edges = {}
    for i = 1, #a.states do
        edges[i] = {}
    end
    for p, row in ipairs(a.transitions) do
        for _, destinations in ipairs(row) do
            for _, q in ipairs(destinations) do
                local from, to = p, q
                if reverse then
                    from, to = q, p
                end
                edges[from][#edges[from] + 1] = to
            end
        end
    end
    local seen, queue = {}, {}
    for _, state in ipairs(starts) do
        if not seen[state] then
            seen[state] = true
            queue[#queue + 1] = state
        end
    end
    local i = 1
    while i <= #queue do
        for _, next_state in ipairs(edges[queue[i]]) do
            if not seen[next_state] then
                seen[next_state] = true
                queue[#queue + 1] = next_state
            end
        end
        i = i + 1
    end
    return seen
end
local function partition_text(a, blocks)
    local parts = {}
    for _, block in ipairs(blocks) do
        parts[#parts + 1] = state_set(a, block)
    end
    return table.concat(parts, " ")
end
local function minimize(a)
    local reachable = graph_reach(a, {a.start}, false)
    local missing, blocks, by_final = {}, {}, {}
    for state = 1, #a.states do
        if not reachable[state] then
            missing[#missing + 1] = state
        else
            local key = a.final[state] and 1 or 0
            local group = by_final[key]
            if not group then
                group = #blocks + 1
                by_final[key] = group
                blocks[group] = {}
            end
            blocks[group][#blocks[group] + 1] = state
        end
    end
    local details = {
        "  unreachable: " .. state_list(a, missing),
        "  round 0: " .. partition_text(a, blocks)
    }
    local round = 1
    while true do
        local membership = {}
        for i, block in ipairs(blocks) do
            for _, state in ipairs(block) do
                membership[state] = i
            end
        end
        local next_blocks, signatures = {}, {}
        for state = 1, #a.states do
            if reachable[state] then
                local signature = {membership[state]}
                for c = 1, #a.alphabet do
                    signature[#signature + 1] = membership[a.transitions[state][c][1]]
                end
                local key = set_key(signature)
                local group = signatures[key]
                if not group then
                    group = #next_blocks + 1
                    signatures[key] = group
                    next_blocks[group] = {}
                end
                next_blocks[group][#next_blocks[group] + 1] = state
            end
        end
        if #next_blocks == #blocks then
            break
        end
        blocks = next_blocks
        details[#details + 1] = string.format("  round %d: %s", round, partition_text(a, blocks))
        round = round + 1
    end
    local membership = {}
    for i, block in ipairs(blocks) do
        for _, state in ipairs(block) do
            membership[state] = i
        end
    end
    local order = {membership[a.start]}
    local indices = {[order[1]] = 1}
    local rows = {}
    local i = 1
    while i <= #order do
        local representative = blocks[order[i]][1]
        local row = {}
        for c = 1, #a.alphabet do
            local group = membership[a.transitions[representative][c][1]]
            local index = indices[group]
            if not index then
                index = #order + 1
                indices[group] = index
                order[index] = group
            end
            row[c] = index
        end
        rows[i] = row
        i = i + 1
    end
    local result = make_automaton("DFA", series("M", #order), a.alphabet, 1)
    for index, group in ipairs(order) do
        result.final[index] = a.final[blocks[group][1]]
        for c, next_state in ipairs(rows[index]) do
            add(result, index, c, next_state)
        end
        details[#details + 1] = string.format("  M%d = %s", index - 1, state_set(a, blocks[group]))
    end
    return result, details
end
local function product(a, b, command)
    local pairs = {{a.start, b.start}}
    local indices = {[set_key(pairs[1])] = 1}
    local rows = {}
    local i = 1
    while i <= #pairs do
        local row = {}
        local pair = pairs[i]
        for c = 1, #a.alphabet do
            local next_pair = {a.transitions[pair[1]][c][1], b.transitions[pair[2]][c][1]}
            local key = set_key(next_pair)
            local index = indices[key]
            if not index then
                index = #pairs + 1
                indices[key] = index
                pairs[index] = next_pair
            end
            row[c] = index
        end
        rows[i] = row
        i = i + 1
    end
    local result = make_automaton("DFA", series("P", #pairs), a.alphabet, 1)
    local details = {}
    for index, pair in ipairs(pairs) do
        local x, y = a.final[pair[1]], b.final[pair[2]]
        result.final[index] =
            command == "UNION" and (x or y) or command == "INTERSECT" and x and y or
            command == "DIFF" and x and not y
        for c, next_state in ipairs(rows[index]) do
            add(result, index, c, next_state)
        end
        details[#details + 1] =
            string.format("  P%d = (%s,%s)", index - 1, a.states[pair[1]], b.states[pair[2]])
    end
    return result, details
end
local function word_text(word)
    return word == "" and "e" or word
end
local function witness(a)
    local queue = {{state = a.start, word = ""}}
    local seen = {[a.start] = true}
    local i = 1
    while i <= #queue do
        local current = queue[i]
        if a.final[current.state] then
            return current.word
        end
        for c = 1, #a.alphabet do
            local next_state = a.transitions[current.state][c][1]
            if not seen[next_state] then
                seen[next_state] = true
                queue[#queue + 1] = {
                    state = next_state,
                    word = current.word .. a.alphabet:sub(c, c)
                }
            end
        end
        i = i + 1
    end
end
local function equivalent(a, b)
    local initial = {a.start, b.start}
    local queue = {{pair = initial, word = ""}}
    local seen = {[set_key(initial)] = true}
    local i = 1
    while i <= #queue do
        local current = queue[i]
        local pair = current.pair
        if a.final[pair[1]] ~= b.final[pair[2]] then
            return current.word, a.final[pair[1]]
        end
        for c = 1, #a.alphabet do
            local next_pair = {a.transitions[pair[1]][c][1], b.transitions[pair[2]][c][1]}
            local key = set_key(next_pair)
            if not seen[key] then
                seen[key] = true
                queue[#queue + 1] = {pair = next_pair, word = current.word .. a.alphabet:sub(c, c)}
            end
        end
        i = i + 1
    end
end
local function language(a)
    local finals = {}
    for state, accepting in ipairs(a.final) do
        if accepting then
            finals[#finals + 1] = state
        end
    end
    local live = graph_reach(a, finals, true)
    if not live[a.start] then
        return "empty", live
    end
    local colors = {}
    local function cycle(state)
        colors[state] = 1
        for c = 1, #a.alphabet do
            local next_state = a.transitions[state][c][1]
            if
                live[next_state] and
                    (colors[next_state] == 1 or not colors[next_state] and cycle(next_state))
             then
                return true
            end
        end
        colors[state] = 2
        return false
    end
    return cycle(a.start) and "infinite" or "finite", live
end
local function finite_count(a, live)
    local memo = {}
    local function count(state)
        if not live[state] then
            return 0
        end
        if memo[state] ~= nil then
            return memo[state]
        end
        local result = a.final[state] and 1 or 0
        for c = 1, #a.alphabet do
            result = result + count(a.transitions[state][c][1])
        end
        memo[state] = result
        return result
    end
    return count(a.start)
end
local function count_length(a, n)
    local counts = {[a.start] = 1}
    for _ = 1, n do
        local next_counts = {}
        for state, count in pairs(counts) do
            for c = 1, #a.alphabet do
                local next_state = a.transitions[state][c][1]
                next_counts[next_state] = (next_counts[next_state] or 0) + count
            end
        end
        counts = next_counts
    end
    local total = 0
    for state, count in pairs(counts) do
        if a.final[state] then
            total = total + count
        end
    end
    return total
end
local function synchronize(a)
    local initial = {}
    for state = 1, #a.states do
        initial[state] = state
    end
    local queue = {{states = initial, word = ""}}
    local seen = {[set_key(initial)] = true}
    local i = 1
    while i <= #queue do
        local current = queue[i]
        if #current.states == 1 then
            return current.word, current.states[1]
        end
        for c = 1, #a.alphabet do
            local present = {}
            for _, state in ipairs(current.states) do
                present[a.transitions[state][c][1]] = true
            end
            local next_states = ordered_set(present, #a.states)
            local key = set_key(next_states)
            if not seen[key] then
                seen[key] = true
                queue[#queue + 1] = {
                    states = next_states,
                    word = current.word .. a.alphabet:sub(c, c)
                }
            end
        end
        i = i + 1
    end
end
local RegexParser = {}
RegexParser.__index = RegexParser
function RegexParser:peek()
    return self.text:sub(self.at, self.at)
end
function RegexParser:invalid()
    fail("syntax error at %d", self.at)
end
local function regex_symbol(c)
    return c ~= "" and (c >= "a" and c <= "z" or c >= "0" and c <= "9")
end
function RegexParser:atom()
    local c = self:peek()
    if regex_symbol(c) then
        self.at = self.at + 1
        return {kind = c, children = {}}
    end
    if c == "(" then
        self.at = self.at + 1
        local result = self:alternation()
        if self:peek() ~= ")" then
            self:invalid()
        end
        self.at = self.at + 1
        return result
    end
    self:invalid()
end
function RegexParser:factor()
    local result = self:atom()
    while contains({"*", "+", "?"}, self:peek()) do
        local c = self:peek()
        self.at = self.at + 1
        result = {kind = c, children = {result}}
    end
    return result
end
function RegexParser:concatenation()
    local children = {self:factor()}
    while regex_symbol(self:peek()) or self:peek() == "(" do
        children[#children + 1] = self:factor()
    end
    return #children == 1 and children[1] or {kind = ".", children = children}
end
function RegexParser:alternation()
    local children = {self:concatenation()}
    while self:peek() == "|" do
        self.at = self.at + 1
        children[#children + 1] = self:concatenation()
    end
    return #children == 1 and children[1] or {kind = "|", children = children}
end
local function regex_automaton(tree, alphabet)
    local transitions, count = {}, 0
    local function state()
        count = count + 1
        return count
    end
    local function transition(p, c, q)
        transitions[#transitions + 1] = {p, c, q}
    end
    local epsilon = #alphabet + 1
    local function build(tree)
        if #tree.children == 0 then
            local s, f = state(), state()
            local c = tree.kind == "e" and epsilon or alphabet:find(tree.kind, 1, true)
            transition(s, c, f)
            return s, f
        end
        if tree.kind == "." then
            local start, previous = build(tree.children[1])
            for i = 2, #tree.children do
                local s, f = build(tree.children[i])
                transition(previous, epsilon, s)
                previous = f
            end
            return start, previous
        end
        local start = state()
        if tree.kind == "|" then
            local parts = {}
            for _, child in ipairs(tree.children) do
                local s, f = build(child)
                parts[#parts + 1] = {s, f}
            end
            local ending = state()
            for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
                transition(start, epsilon, part[1])
                transition(part[2], epsilon, ending)
            end
            return start, ending
        end
        local s, f = build(tree.children[1])
        local ending = state()
        transition(start, epsilon, s)
        transition(f, epsilon, ending)
        if tree.kind ~= "?" then
            transition(f, epsilon, s)
        end
        if tree.kind ~= "+" then
            transition(start, epsilon, ending)
        end
        return start, ending
    end
    local start, ending = build(tree)
    local result = make_automaton("NFA", series("N", count), alphabet, start)
    result.final[ending] = true
    for _, triple in ipairs(transitions) do
        add(result, triple[1], triple[2], triple[3])
    end
    return result
end
local function sorted_alphabet(text)
    local chars = {}
    for c in text:gmatch(".") do
        chars[#chars + 1] = c
    end
    table.sort(chars)
    return table.concat(chars)
end
local function state_index(a, name)
    for i, state in ipairs(a.states) do
        if state == name then
            return i
        end
    end
    fail("unknown state %s", name)
end
local Toolkit = {}
Toolkit.__index = Toolkit
function Toolkit:find(name)
    for _, entry in ipairs(self.entries) do
        if entry.name == name then
            return entry.automaton
        end
    end
end
function Toolkit:register(name, a, details)
    self.entries[#self.entries + 1] = {name = name, automaton = a}
    local out = {summary(a, name)}
    for _, text in ipairs(details or {}) do
        out[#out + 1] = text
    end
    return out
end
function Toolkit:define(command, args)
    if #args < 5 then
        fail("wrong number of arguments")
    end
    local name = args[1]
    if self:find(name) then
        fail("%s already exists", name)
    end
    local states = split(args[2], ",")
    local seen = {}
    for _, state in ipairs(states) do
        if seen[state] then
            fail("duplicate state %s", state)
        end
        seen[state] = true
    end
    local a = make_automaton(command, states, sorted_alphabet(args[3]), 1)
    a.start = state_index(a, args[4])
    if args[5] ~= "-" then
        for _, state in ipairs(split(args[5], ",")) do
            local index = state_index(a, state)
            if a.final[index] then
                fail("duplicate state %s", state)
            end
            a.final[index] = true
        end
    end
    local triples, pairs = {}, {}
    for i = 6, #args do
        local word = args[i]
        local parts = split(word, ":")
        local p = state_index(a, parts[1])
        local c = a.alphabet:find(parts[2], 1, true)
        if parts[2] == "e" then
            if command == "DFA" then
                fail("epsilon transition in DFA")
            end
            c = #a.alphabet + 1
        elseif not c then
            fail("unknown symbol %s", parts[2])
        end
        local q = state_index(a, parts[3])
        if triples[word] then
            fail("duplicate transition %s", word)
        end
        triples[word] = true
        local key = p .. ":" .. c
        if command == "DFA" and pairs[key] then
            fail("conflicting transition %s", word)
        end
        pairs[key] = true
        add(a, p, c, q)
    end
    if command == "DFA" then
        for state = 1, #states do
            for c = 1, #a.alphabet do
                if #a.transitions[state][c] == 0 then
                    fail("missing transition %s:%s", a.states[state], a.alphabet:sub(c, c))
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return self:register(name, a)
end
local counts = {
    ACCEPT = 2,
    CLOSURE = 2,
    TODFA = 2,
    EPSFREE = 2,
    MINIMIZE = 2,
    EQUIV = 2,
    UNION = 3,
    INTERSECT = 3,
    DIFF = 3,
    COMPLEMENT = 2,
    REVERSE = 2,
    CONCAT = 3,
    STAR = 2,
    ENUM = 2,
    COUNT = 2,
    EMPTY = 1,
    FINITE = 1,
    INFO = 1,
    TABLE = 1,
    SHOW = 1,
    SYNC = 1,
    LIST = 0,
    DELETE = 1
}
function Toolkit:command(words)
    local command = table.remove(words, 1)
    local args = words
    if command == "DFA" or command == "NFA" then
        return self:define(command, args)
    end
    if command == "REGEX" then
        if #args ~= 3 then
            fail("wrong number of arguments")
        end
        if self:find(args[1]) then
            fail("%s already exists", args[1])
        end
        local alphabet = sorted_alphabet(args[2])
        for c in args[3]:gmatch(".") do
            if regex_symbol(c) and c ~= "e" and not alphabet:find(c, 1, true) then
                fail("unknown symbol %s", c)
            end
        end
        local parser = setmetatable({text = args[3], at = 1}, RegexParser)
        local tree = parser:alternation()
        if parser.at <= #parser.text then
            parser:invalid()
        end
        return self:register(args[1], regex_automaton(tree, alphabet))
    end
    if counts[command] == nil then
        fail("unknown command %s", command)
    end
    if #args ~= counts[command] then
        fail("wrong number of arguments")
    end
    if command == "LIST" then
        local out = {}
        for _, entry in ipairs(self.entries) do
            out[#out + 1] = summary(entry.automaton, entry.name)
        end
        return #out == 0 and {"(none)"} or out
    end
    local reference_count =
        contains({"EQUIV", "UNION", "INTERSECT", "DIFF", "CONCAT"}, command) and 2 or 1
    local autos = {}
    for i = 1, reference_count do
        autos[i] = self:find(args[i])
        if not autos[i] then
            fail("unknown automaton %s", args[i])
        end
    end
    local creates =
        contains(
        {
            "TODFA",
            "EPSFREE",
            "MINIMIZE",
            "UNION",
            "INTERSECT",
            "DIFF",
            "COMPLEMENT",
            "REVERSE",
            "CONCAT",
            "STAR"
        },
        command
    )
    if creates and self:find(args[#args]) then
        fail("%s already exists", args[#args])
    end
    if contains({"MINIMIZE", "UNION", "INTERSECT", "DIFF", "COMPLEMENT", "SYNC"}, command) then
        for i, a in ipairs(autos) do
            if a.kind ~= "DFA" then
                fail("%s is not a DFA", args[i])
            end
        end
    end
    if reference_count == 2 and autos[1].alphabet ~= autos[2].alphabet then
        fail("alphabets differ")
    end
    local a = autos[1]
    if command == "DELETE" then
        for i, entry in ipairs(self.entries) do
            if entry.name == args[1] then
                table.remove(self.entries, i)
                break
            end
        end
        return {"deleted " .. args[1]}
    elseif command == "ACCEPT" then
        local word = args[2] == "e" and "" or args[2]
        for c in word:gmatch(".") do
            if not a.alphabet:find(c, 1, true) then
                fail("unknown symbol %s", c)
            end
        end
        local states = closure(a, {a.start})
        local function display(states)
            return a.kind == "DFA" and a.states[states[1]] or state_set(a, states)
        end
        local path = display(states)
        for c in word:gmatch(".") do
            states = destination(a, states, a.alphabet:find(c, 1, true))
            path = path .. " -" .. c .. "-> " .. display(states)
        end
        return {(accepts(a, states) and "ACCEPT" or "REJECT") .. " " .. path}
    elseif command == "CLOSURE" then
        local states = {}
        for _, state in ipairs(split(args[2], ",")) do
            states[#states + 1] = state_index(a, state)
        end
        return {state_set(a, closure(a, states))}
    elseif command == "TODFA" then
        local result, sets = determinize(a)
        local details = {}
        for i, set in ipairs(sets) do
            details[#details + 1] = string.format("  D%d = %s", i - 1, state_set(a, set))
        end
        return self:register(args[2], result, details)
    elseif command == "EPSFREE" then
        local result = make_automaton("NFA", a.states, a.alphabet, a.start)
        for state = 1, #a.states do
            local closed = closure(a, {state})
            result.final[state] = accepts(a, closed)
            for c = 1, #a.alphabet do
                for _, next_state in ipairs(destination(a, closed, c)) do
                    add(result, state, c, next_state)
                end
            end
        end
        return self:register(args[2], result)
    elseif command == "MINIMIZE" then
        local result, details = minimize(a)
        return self:register(args[2], result, details)
    elseif command == "UNION" or command == "INTERSECT" or command == "DIFF" then
        local result, details = product(a, autos[2], command)
        return self:register(args[3], result, details)
    elseif command == "EQUIV" then
        local x, z = determinize(a), determinize(autos[2])
        local word, left = equivalent(x, z)
        if word == nil then
            return {"EQUIVALENT"}
        end
        return {
            string.format(
                "NOT EQUIVALENT: %s is accepted only by %s",
                word_text(word),
                left and args[1] or args[2]
            )
        }
    elseif command == "COMPLEMENT" then
        local result = make_automaton("DFA", a.states, a.alphabet, a.start)
        for state = 1, #a.states do
            result.final[state] = not a.final[state]
            for c = 1, #a.alphabet do
                add(result, state, c, a.transitions[state][c][1])
            end
        end
        return self:register(args[2], result)
    elseif command == "REVERSE" or command == "CONCAT" or command == "STAR" then
        local total, start = #a.states + 1, 1
        if command == "CONCAT" then
            total, start = #a.states + #autos[2].states, a.start
        end
        local result = make_automaton("NFA", series("N", total), a.alphabet, start)
        local epsilon = #a.alphabet + 1
        if command == "REVERSE" then
            for p, row in ipairs(a.transitions) do
                for c, destinations in ipairs(row) do
                    for _, q in ipairs(destinations) do
                        add(result, q + 1, c, p + 1)
                    end
                end
            end
            for state, accepting in ipairs(a.final) do
                if accepting then
                    add(result, 1, epsilon, state + 1)
                end
            end
            result.final[a.start + 1] = true
        elseif command == "STAR" then
            for p, row in ipairs(a.transitions) do
                for c, destinations in ipairs(row) do
                    for _, q in ipairs(destinations) do
                        add(result, p + 1, c, q + 1)
                    end
                end
            end
            result.final[1] = true
            add(result, 1, epsilon, a.start + 1)
            for state, accepting in ipairs(a.final) do
                if accepting then
                    result.final[state + 1] = true
                    add(result, state + 1, epsilon, a.start + 1)
                end
            end
        else
            for p, row in ipairs(a.transitions) do
                for c, destinations in ipairs(row) do
                    for _, q in ipairs(destinations) do
                        add(result, p, c, q)
                    end
                end
            end
            local b, offset = autos[2], #a.states
            for p, row in ipairs(b.transitions) do
                for c, destinations in ipairs(row) do
                    for _, q in ipairs(destinations) do
                        add(result, p + offset, c, q + offset)
                    end
                end
            end
            for state, accepting in ipairs(a.final) do
                if accepting then
                    add(result, state, epsilon, b.start + offset)
                end
            end
            for state, accepting in ipairs(b.final) do
                result.final[state + offset] = accepting
            end
        end
        return self:register(args[#args], result)
    elseif command == "SYNC" then
        local word, state = synchronize(a)
        return word and {string.format("SYNCHRONIZING %s -> %s", word_text(word), a.states[state])} or
            {"NOT SYNCHRONIZING"}
    elseif command == "COUNT" then
        return {tostring(count_length(determinize(a), tonumber(args[2])))}
    elseif command == "ENUM" then
        local k, d = tonumber(args[2]), determinize(a)
        local queue = {{state = d.start, word = ""}}
        local total, accepted, i = 0, {}, 1
        while i <= #queue do
            local current = queue[i]
            if d.final[current.state] then
                total = total + 1
                if #accepted < 50 then
                    accepted[#accepted + 1] = word_text(current.word)
                end
            end
            if #current.word < k then
                for c = 1, #d.alphabet do
                    queue[#queue + 1] = {
                        state = d.transitions[current.state][c][1],
                        word = current.word .. d.alphabet:sub(c, c)
                    }
                end
            end
            i = i + 1
        end
        local text = tostring(total)
        if #accepted > 0 then
            text = text .. " " .. table.concat(accepted, " ")
        end
        if total > 50 then
            text = text .. " ..."
        end
        return {text}
    elseif command == "EMPTY" then
        local word = witness(determinize(a))
        return word and {"NOT EMPTY " .. word_text(word)} or {"EMPTY"}
    elseif command == "FINITE" then
        local d = determinize(a)
        local classification, live = language(d)
        return classification == "infinite" and {"INFINITE"} or {"FINITE " .. finite_count(d, live)}
    elseif command == "INFO" then
        local epsilon, deterministic, complete = 0, true, true
        local finals = {}
        for state, accepting in ipairs(a.final) do
            if accepting then
                finals[#finals + 1] = state
            end
            epsilon = epsilon + #a.transitions[state][#a.alphabet + 1]
            for c = 1, #a.alphabet do
                if #a.transitions[state][c] > 1 then
                    deterministic = false
                end
                if #a.transitions[state][c] == 0 then
                    complete = false
                end
            end
        end
        if epsilon > 0 then
            deterministic = false
        end
        local d = determinize(a)
        local classification = language(d)
        local minimal = minimize(d)
        local function yes(value)
            return value and "yes" or "no"
        end
        return {
            summary(a, args[1]),
            "  epsilon transitions: " .. epsilon,
            "  reachable: " ..
                state_list(a, ordered_set(graph_reach(a, {a.start}, false), #a.states)),
            "  live: " .. state_list(a, ordered_set(graph_reach(a, finals, true), #a.states)),
            "  deterministic: " .. yes(deterministic),
            "  complete: " .. yes(complete),
            "  language: " .. classification,
            "  minimal DFA states: " .. #minimal.states
        }
    elseif command == "SHOW" then
        local finals = {}
        for state, accepting in ipairs(a.final) do
            if accepting then
                finals[#finals + 1] = a.states[state]
            end
        end
        local parts = {
            a.kind,
            args[1],
            table.concat(a.states, ","),
            a.alphabet,
            a.states[a.start],
            #finals == 0 and "-" or table.concat(finals, ",")
        }
        for p, row in ipairs(a.transitions) do
            for c, destinations in ipairs(row) do
                local symbol = c <= #a.alphabet and a.alphabet:sub(c, c) or "e"
                for _, q in ipairs(destinations) do
                    parts[#parts + 1] = a.states[p] .. ":" .. symbol .. ":" .. a.states[q]
                end
            end
        end
        return {table.concat(parts, " ")}
    elseif command == "TABLE" then
        local columns = #a.alphabet + 1
        local epsilon = false
        if a.kind == "NFA" then
            for state = 1, #a.states do
                if #a.transitions[state][#a.alphabet + 1] > 0 then
                    epsilon = true
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if epsilon then
            columns = columns + 1
        end
        local header = {""}
        for c = 1, columns - 1 do
            header[c + 1] = c <= #a.alphabet and a.alphabet:sub(c, c) or "e"
        end
        local rows = {header}
        for state, name in ipairs(a.states) do
            local row = {
                (state == a.start and "->" or "  ") .. (a.final[state] and "*" or " ") .. name
            }
            for c = 1, columns - 1 do
                local destinations = a.transitions[state][c]
                row[c + 1] =
                    a.kind == "DFA" and a.states[destinations[1]] or #destinations == 0 and "-" or
                    state_set(a, destinations)
            end
            rows[#rows + 1] = row
        end
        local widths = {}
        for c = 1, columns do
            widths[c] = 0
            for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
                widths[c] = math.max(widths[c], #row[c])
            end
        end
        local lines = {}
        for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
            local cells = {}
            for c, text in ipairs(row) do
                cells[c] = text .. string.rep(" ", widths[c] - #text)
            end
            lines[#lines + 1] = (table.concat(cells, "  "):gsub(" +$", ""))
        end
        return lines
    end
end
local toolkit = setmetatable({entries = {}}, Toolkit)
local count = tonumber(io.read("*l"))
for _ = 1, count do
    local line = io.read("*l")
    if line:sub(1, 1) ~= "#" then
        local ok, result =
            pcall(
            function()
                return toolkit:command(split(line, " "))
            end
        )
        if not ok then
            if type(result) ~= "table" or not result.reason then
                error(result, 0)
            end
            io.write("error: ", result.reason, "\n")
        else
            for _, text in ipairs(result) do
                io.write(text, "\n")
            end
        end
    end
end
